note: Adapted from Constantino's (1995) revision, originally in English. The alate, the soldier and the worker are described. Alate measurements: 6 colonies, 9 alates, head length 2.90—3.10 mm, head width without the eyes 3.30—3.70 mm, fontanelle length 0.32—0.47 mm, pronotum length 2.15—2.40 mm and width 3.65—4.25 mm, hind tibia length 6.30—7.10 mm, maximum diameter of the compound eye 0.92—1.08 mm, ocellus length 0.37—0.44 mm, fore wing length 29.50—32.00 mm. Soldier measurements: 28 colonies, 28 soldiers, head length 3.60—6.80 mm, head height without postmentum 3.10—3.70 mm, frontal tube length 0.08—0.30 mm, left mandible length 3.00—3.40 mm, curvature 1.20—1.60 mm, left mandible M1—M2 distance 0.67—0.92 mm. The original also points out that S. grandis, S. hageni and S. lighti lack consistent distinguishing characters and may be a single continuous variation (large series collected by Mathews in Mato Grosso included all three). OCR word breaks (e.g. “3.(i()-6.80”) have been corrected from the context; the head width value, damaged in the OCR, has not been entered.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate most similar to S. magnoculus and S. obtusus, the former apparently indistinguishable from S. grandis; the alate of S. obtusus has distinctly larger compound eyes and an elongated fontanelle. The soldier of S. magnoculus is similar but larger, with larger marginal teeth on both mandibles and an apical cutting edge that is not S-shaped. The soldier of S. wheeleri is also similar and sometimes difficult to distinguish, but the latter is smaller, the sides of the head more parallel, the mandibles straighter with smaller marginal teeth, and the head with more hairs.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Compound eyes large, diameter greater than 1/4 to about 1/3 of the head width; ocelli relatively large; fontanelle round, small to medium. Antennae 20-segmented. Anterior corners of the pronotum rounded to moderately angular; lateral margins straight, the anterior half nearly parallel or rounded and converging posteriorly. Wings long; media and cubitus not distinct apically. Head capsule densely covered with erect setae; postclypeus with about 16 setae; outer margins and surface of the pronotum hairy; abdominal tergites hairy from the middle to the posterior margin.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule short, head length and width nearly equal, the sides slightly to distinctly converging anteriorly; posterior margin of the head round or weakly trilobed. Frontal tube very short, the opening clearly visible in dorsal view. Labrum short, length and width nearly equal; lateral corners nearly right-angled; median lobe short.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Worker: head capsule with many erect setae; postclypeus with about 10 setae; fontanelle small and slightly elongated. Antennae 20 or 21-segmented. Thoracic tergite spines weak.
